- Now supports querying homes.com using the fpx CLI, eliminating the need for the homes-mcp server.
- Enables searching listings, resolving street addresses, fetching property details/photos/history, and accessing the signed-in user's saved homes directly through your own browser session.
- Uses the Transporter browser extension to route all requests through an active, signed-in homes.com tab, bypassing AWS WAF challenges.
- Provides extraction recipes for search, property detail, typeahead, market reports, saved homes/searches, and other endpoints.
- Detailed setup instructions and ready-to-use shell command examples included in the documentation.
